visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand wearing a black sleeve places a smartphone with a stopwatch app running on a light wooden floor next to a white ceramic bowl filled with wet cat food. A foot in a white sock is partially visible at the bottom. A small black and white kitten stands near the bowl. (2) The kitten begins eating the food extremely rapidly, its head moving up and down with intense focus. The stopwatch on the phone counts up. The environment is a clean, bright indoor home setting with wooden shelves in the background. (3) Close-up shots show the kitten finishing the entire bowl of food. The stopwatch displays approximately 6 minutes. The kitten licks its mouth and walks away from the empty plate. (4) The scene cuts to a larger white cat with black spots eating slowly from a heart-shaped white bowl on a wooden table. It takes small bites with long pauses. (5) A tabby cat is shown in a different indoor setting. Several bowls of food are lined up. The cat sniffs one bowl, looks around, and appears hesitant to eat. (6) A ginger and white cat sniffs its bowl of food on the wooden floor, licks its chops once, and then turns its head away, refusing to eat. (7) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring white brand text and a logo in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, bright pop music begins with a dominant synthesizer melody and a steady 120 BPM electronic drum beat. There are no human vocals. (2) A sharp digital 'click' sound effect triggers as the timer starts visually. (3) A sequence of rhythmic 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effects occurs, tightly synchronized with the kitten's fast eating motions and the visual cuts. (4) A synthetic 'whoosh' transition sound marks the shift from the kitten segment to the adult cat segment. (5) The music continues its upbeat, major-mode loop, but the SFX density decreases as the visual pace slows down. (6) A final digital 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of the end-screen logo.
